authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10875.2 *lakkuṭa gives Lahnda lakkaṛ wood and Awan lukṛī wood, with the possible influence of rukkh explicitly noted, beside Gawri lēkeṛī firewood. Pothwari lukoṛ fits the retained-k wood family with the intervening vowel and final rhotic retained. The selected subsection avoids the k-losing laur branch; local contact remains open. Exact response: lukoṛ.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 11109 leṭyati gives Lahnda leṭaṇ, Punjabi/Western Pahari leṭṇā, Nepali leṭnu and Hindi leṭnā lie down. The selected bare leṭ and simple leṭa/leṭo responses use this stem; leṭṇā is an ordinary infinitive explicitly documented by the entry. Mixed imperative/past elicitation labels and source final vowels are retained. The proposed deeper non-Aryan connection and local Indo-Aryan transmission remain unresolved. Exact response: leṭ.
